_readme: Single source of truth for every model this project uses, has considered, or is
considering. Read by notebooks/model_prefetch_to_drive.ipynb, which fetches only the
entries with fetch_now=true. Append new entries here instead of editing the notebook's
code cell directly -- that is the one obvious place to add a model. See AGENTS.md
'Model downloads' for the fetch-before-you-add-it rule this file supports.
Fields: name (archive/catalog key), repo_id (HF repo, null if not yet pinned),
revision (pinned commit or null), allow_patterns (HF snapshot_download filter or null),
role (why the project wants it), license, size_gb (approximate, only recorded when known
without downloading), status (local+drive | drive_only | local_only | needed | candidate |
rejected), fetch_now (true only for entries the prefetch notebook should actually pull
status/fetch_now are facts about this file as last verified, not live state -- re-check
`ls ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/` before trusting them for a download decision.

models.name: qwen3-tts-voicedesign-4bit
models.role: Generates short reference/eval clips with a described (not cloned) voice, for issues #52/#118 -- not for narrating whole chapters
models.notes: DEFAULT PICK, see notebook cell 3 for the reasoning: smallest footprint, leaves the most headroom on M1/16GB alongside other resident processes, and the model's job here is short clips, not long-form narration where quantization artifacts would accumulate. Switch fetch_now to the 8bit or bf16 sibling below instead (not in addition) if 4bit audio quality proves inadequate by ear.

models.name: qwen3-tts-voicedesign-8bit
models.role: Same as qwen3-tts-voicedesign-4bit; higher-fidelity alternative
models.notes: size_gb interpolated between the 4bit and bf16 checkpoints, not independently confirmed. Promote to fetch_now=true only if 4bit quality is judged insufficient.

models.name: qwen3-tts-voicedesign-bf16
models.role: Same as qwen3-tts-voicedesign-4bit; full-precision alternative
models.notes: Matches the CustomVoice bf16 checkpoint's footprint (README: 8.07 GB peak) -- viable on M1/16GB alone, but leaves the least headroom if run alongside another resident model. Use only if 4bit/8bit quality is judged insufficient.

Do not fetch unless #114 reopens this decision.
